newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Village to complete full Austereo takeover.
newsitem.headline: Village to complete full Austereo takeover.

text.p: Entertainment group and cinema operator Village Roadshow Ltd said on Wednesday it was now entitled to 97 percent of its takeover target, radio group Austereo Ltd, and would move to compulsorily buy the rest of Austereo's shares.
Last month, Village lifted its takeover bid for Austereo to A$2.55 a share from A$2.35 and the offer was later extended to May 23.
Austereo's independent directors later recommended shareholders accept the offer, which had been described by an independent report as fair and reasonable.
Austereo's shares were steady at A$2.55 at 2.20 p.m. (0420 GMT), while Village's shares were down three cents at A$4.22.
